previewNormalization.video: BT.709 SDR, limited range; no HDR transform
previewNormalization.jpeg: Camera JPEG RGB interpretation is provisional: EXIF ColorSpace 65535 and no embedded ICC. Resolve operator must confirm input profile from camera/RAW.
previewNormalization.encoding: Scale converts preview YUV matrix to BT.709 and limited range, all events tagged consistently. This is not ICC/gamut correction or final creative grading.
